arabic text: USKI DUNYA GHULAM HOTI HAI, JO ALI KA GHULAM HOTA HAI\nRANG E HAIDER KA JIS PER CHAR JAAYE\nUSKA MAR KAR BHI NAAM HOTA HAI
english translation text: THE WORLD IS HIS SLAVE, THE ONE WHO IS THE SLAVE OF ALI\nTHE ONE WHO IS COVERED IN THE LOVE OF ALI\nHIS NAME REMAINS EVEN AFTER DYING

arabic text: SARKAR ALAMDAR DO ALAM KA MADAD GAAR, HAIDER E KARRAR\nPEERON ME MERA PEER ZABARDAST HAI SARKAR, HAIDER E KARRAR
english translation text: MASTER, FLAGBEARER, THE HELPER OF THE UNIVERSE, HAIDER E KARRAR!\nMASTER OF ALL MASTERS, THE MAGNIFICIENT LEADER, HAIDER E KARRAR

arabic text:
SHAHON SE BHI ALA HAI TERE DAR KA GADA GAR
KARTE HAI GHULAMI TERE DUNYA KE SIKANDAR
AALA HAI HAI AMEERON SE FAKEERON KE MUQADAR
JANAT KE HAI TAJIR TERI DEHLEEZ KE NOKAR
NARA E HAIDERI MOLA, NARA E KHAYBARI MOLA, NARA E SAFDARI MOLA, NARA E QAMBAR MOLA
MESUM NE LAGAYA HAI YEHI NAARA SAR E DAAR – HAIDER E KARRAR
english translation text:
THE ONE WHO BOWS AT YOUR DOOR STEP IS HIGHER THAN THE KINGS
THE ONE WHO HAS EVERYTHING IS STILL YOUR SLAVE
THE DESTINY OF A BEGGAR (AT YOUR DOOR) IS HIGHER THAN THE MOST WEALTHY ONE
YOUR SERVANTS DEAL IN THE CURRENCY OF THE HEAVENS
MESUM (MAYTHAM) RECITED THIS ‘NAARA’ (CHAANT) ON THE TREE

arabic text: SARKAR ALAMDAR DO ALAM KA MADAD GAAR, HAIDER E KARRAR\nPEERON ME MERA PEER ZABARDAST HAI SARKAR, HAIDER E KARRAR
english translation text: MASTER, FLAGBEARER, THE HELPER OF THE UNIVERSE, HAIDER E KARRAR!\nMASTER OF ALL MASTERS, THE MAGNIFICIENT LEADER, HAIDER E KARRAR

arabic text:
ALLAH KA ANMOL JO SHAHKAAR BANA HAI
ISLAM KA AALA JO ALAMDAAR BANA HAI
MUSHKIL ME JO NABYION KA MADADGAAR BANA HAI
WO SAARE IMAMO KA JO SARDAR BANA HAI
KUL E IMAAN HAI MOLA
DEEN KI SHAN HAI MOLA, SHAH E MARDAN HAI MOLA, SHERE YAZDAN HAI MOLA
KEHTE HAI NABI APNA JISE WARIS E DASTAR – HAIDER E KARRAR
english translation text:
THE ONE WHO IS A UNIQUE CREATION OF GOD
THE ONE WHO IS A LOFTY FLAGBEARER OF ISLAM
THE ONE WHO HELPED THE PROPHETS
THE ONE WHO IS THE LEADER OF THE IMAMS
THE ONE WHOM THE PROPHET CALLS HIS RIGHTFUL SUCCESSOR

arabic text: SARKAR ALAMDAR DO ALAM KA MADAD GAAR, HAIDER E KARRAR\nPEERON ME MERA PEER ZABARDAST HAI SARKAR, HAIDER E KARRAR
english translation text: MASTER, FLAGBEARER, THE HELPER OF THE UNIVERSE, HAIDER E KARRAR!\nMASTER OF ALL MASTERS, THE MAGNIFICIENT LEADER, HAIDER E KARRAR

arabic text:
SADAAT KI PUR AZM QAYAADAT ME ALI HAI
SHABBIR KE ANDAZ E IBADAT ME ALI HAI
SAJJAD KI ZAINAB KI KHITABAT ME ALI HAI
ABBAS KE PARCHAM KE JALALAT ME ALI HAI
ALI ASGHER ME BHI MOLA
ALI AKBAR ME BHI MOLA, AALE ATHAR ME BHI MOLA, HAAN BAHATAR ME BHI MOLA
HAI PAAK GHARANA TERA ISLAM KA MEMAAR
english translation text:
ALI IS THE LEADER OF THE LINEAGE OF THE FAMILY OF THE HOLY PROPHET
ALI IS IN THE ESSENCE OF THE PRAYERS OF HUSSAIN
HE IS IN THE ESSENCE OF THE SPEECH OF SAJJAD AND ZAINAB
HE IS IN THE VALOUR OF THE FLAG OF ABBAS
HE IS IN THE PURE FAMILY
HE IS IN THE SEVENTY TWO
HE IS IN ALI ASGHER
HE IS IN ALI AKBAR
YOUR PURE FAMILY IS THE FOUNDATION OF ISLAM

arabic text: SARKAR ALAMDAR DO ALAM KA MADAD GAAR, HAIDER E KARRAR\nPEERON ME MERA PEER ZABARDAST HAI SARKAR, HAIDER E KARRAR

arabic text:
SARKAR YEH SAB AAPKI ZOWJA KI DUA HAI
GHAR GHAR ME JO YEH MATAM E SAADAAT BAPA HAI
(ZAHRA SA)
HAR DIL TERE BACHON KA AZA KHAANA BANA HAI
AANKHEN HAI NAJAF DIL ME BASI KARBOBALA HAI
HUM AZADAR HAI MOLA, HUM WAFADAAR HAI MOLA, TERE GHAM KHWAAR HAI MOLA, AAP SARDAR HAI MOLA, SARKAAR BANA LIJIYE APNA HUM E ZAWWAR
english translation text:
O MASTER, THIS IS THE PRAYER OF YOUR WIFE
THE LAMENTATIONS AND EULOGIES THAT ECHO FROM PEOPLE’S HOUSES
EVERY HEART PAINS IN THE MEMORY OF YOUR CHILDREN
NAJAF IS IN OUR EYES, KARBALA IN OUR HEARTS
WE ARE AZADAAR
WE ARE LOYAL TO YOU
WE ARE YOUR MOURNERS
YOU ARE OUR LEADER
MASTER, MAKE US YOUR ZAWWAR
